title: GWAYA-Lite on a Tesla T4 (PR #21 P1/P2): VRAM, tok/s and MBPP pass@1 of Qwen2.5-Coder Q4_K_M tiers via Ollama
notes: Numbers only; no claim is made here.
VRAM measured = max(delta after load+1 token, delta after the ~85% prompt) over the idle baseline read right before the load (CUDA context included).
Estimator = PR #21 constants (weights 1070/1840/4466 MiB + kv_kib_per_token x ctx/1024 + 600 MiB).
Loop candidates are generated lazily (an earlier verified candidate makes later ones irrelevant); seeds from (task_id, sample_index); the greedy reply of R is the first candidate of L.
Hidden outcome = all MBPP tests (the visible test is one of them); 'VERIFIED' = zero-stub audit clean + visible test passed in the E15 sandbox (not GWAYA's Bubblewrap oracle).
Ollama greedy decoding is not guaranteed bit-stable: see the determinism repeat.
Model seconds = Ollama total_duration minus load_duration, summed over calls.
